name: Visual Studio Code Tunnel Shell Execution
description: Detects the execution of a shell (powershell, bash, wsl...) via Visual Studio Code tunnel. Attackers can abuse this functionality to establish a C2 channel and execute arbitrary commands on the system.
author: GAI_CTI
false_positives: Legitimate use of Visual Studio Code tunnel and running code from there
query: (process.parent.executable:*\\servers\\Stable\-* AND process.parent.executable:*\\server\\node.exe AND process.parent.command_line:*.vscode\-server*) AND (((process.executable:(*\\powershell.exe OR *\\pwsh.exe)) AND process.command_line:*\\terminal\\browser\\media\\shellIntegration.ps1*) OR (process.executable:(*\\wsl.exe OR *\\bash.exe)))
